title: My First Coloring Book: Flowers (Part 2)
developmental_focus: Fine-motor coloring practice (whole-hand/early tripod crayon grasp) paired with flower/nature vocabulary, continuing from Part 1 with 8 additional items. Thick, bold outlines only -- no fine detail or small enclosed regions.
safety_notes: One flower/nature element per page, single simple black-line outline on white, no fine internal detail.
No small enclosed regions that are impossible for a 2-3 year old to color inside of.
Line art only, no pre-filled color -- coloring is the point of this book.
Part 2 of an open vocabulary set -- no sequencing dependency on Part 1, can be read/colored in any order.
